Name: Earthy Recolour map fix for Immersive Farm 4
Author: Stuicide
Description:
This mod will make the in game Map display an accurate Farm layout if you are using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7399]Immersive Farm 4[/url] in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url] amazing colour tones.

Installation:
1. Copy the .png files from 'this mod/LooseSprites'
2. Paste them to '[CP] DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour/assets/LooseSprites'
3. Overwrite all files
4. In '[CP] DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour/config.json' set "enableMiniMap" to "true"

None of these assets are mine. All I did was make some edits pasting assets from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/62135416]Xryzo11[/url] over [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/61079406]DaisyNiko[/url] assets.

This will disable the visual of the the Vanilla Grandpa's Farm in the map. If you decide to go for a vanilla farm map run with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url], then you will have to reinstall the mod.

Redistribute as much as you like, I do not even desire credit, as I will not likely maintain it should DaisyNiko make any changes or updates it will revert to her normally intended function. You will have to repeat the installation process for this tweak anytime you update [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url].

Credits:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/61079406]DaisyNiko[/url]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]; an amazing recolour mod, and in my honest opinion, the best available.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/85287593]sexynes[/url]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7399]Immersive Farm 4[/url]; one of my favorite Maps, a spiritual successor to an amazing map Immersive Farm.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/62135416]Xryzo11[/url]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12326]Earthy Recolour map fix[/url]; assets were intended for Immersive Farm 2 Redux, I applied them to Immersive Farm 4.

All images were also ripped directly from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/62135416]Xryzo11[/url]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12326]Earthy Recolour map fix

[/url]If DaisyNiko decides to add innate compatibility with Immersive Farm 4, will discontinue this tweak.
